notes: Sarita Handa (Magento-based, India). Direct HTTP fetch worked for everything (homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, full header/footer mega-menu, site search) -- no bypass needed, no Claude-specific robots disallow. Checked: (1) full main nav + header mega-menu + footer links on homepage (captured every <a> label in the nav block) -- categories present are New In/New Arrivals, The Final Few, Cushions, Bed Linen, Furniture, Fabrics, Wall Covering, Table Linen, Decor, Bath & Wellness, Gifting; no Bestsellers/Best Sellers/Top Sellers/Popular/Customer Favorites/Trending nav item anywhere. (2) Full sitemap.xml (~2018 URLs) grepped case-insensitively for best-sell*/bestsell*/top-sell*/top-pick/popular/trending/favourite/favorite/editor/most-loved/customer-fav -- zero matches. (3) Site's own search (/catalogsearch/result/?q=...): 'bestseller' -> 0 results ('Your search returned no results'); 'best seller' -> 3 results, but these are just catalogsearch PDP hits for individual products that happen to mention the phrase, not a merchandising PLP (search-results pages are explicitly excluded by brief Sec 3/5). No genuine Bestsellers-type PLP exists on this site. This is a correct absence finding, not a failure.
